entry.name: ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
entry.note: Credentials against the AI management system standard the compliance section tracks
entry.audience: AI management system implementers and auditors

covers: Regulatory and ethical considerations around AI implementation
Aligning AI initiatives with an organization's core business objectives
Developing and implementing an AI management system
Evaluating the quality, reliability and performance of AI systems
Ensuring AI solutions meet standards and work as intended
Identifying AI-related risks and putting mitigation measures in place
reading.format: Delivered as training courses. The page does not state how the courses or any exam are assessed.
reading.summary: PECB offers training courses on ISO/IEC 42001, the standard that sets out requirements and guidance for establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving an artificial intelligence management system (AIMS) inside an organization. The courses are meant to build the competencies needed to plan, develop, implement, maintain and improve such a system. Holding a PECB ISO/IEC 42001 certificate is presented as showing that the holder can support an organization in these tasks and in aligning AI work with business goals.
reading.audience: Individuals who want proficiency in artificial intelligence management systems and who want to help organizations plan, develop, implement, maintain and improve an AIMS.
